in_marathi.name: Ashmika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of life
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashmika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ashmika is a Sanskrit name derived from the Ashmaka tree, which is believed to symbolize life and longevity. The name is often associated with the goddess Ashmakini, who is known for her nurturing and protective qualities. In Hindu mythology, Ashmika is believed to bring happiness, prosperity, and good fortune.
